_comment: ASSETS.md section 2. Every asset in this project needs an entry: source, author, licence, date retrieved, attribution text. Originals are re-fetched per the download_url and hash-verified by the build (see .gitignore); only the manifest and licence copies are committed. tools/manifest-check verifies these hashes during the build and fails it if one does not match, so an unlicensed or uncredited asset cannot ship.
